highlights: Command Center now uses the built-in DR BOAT map engine instead of embedded OpenCPN
AIS overlay independent of VECTOR / SATELLITE / HYBRID / MARINE map mode
Local AIS NMEA AIVDM/AIVDO position decoding on UDP 10110 for message types 1/2/3/18
AIS target details include MMSI, SOG, COG, heading, age, CPA and TCPA
Professional Voyage Dashboard with planned-speed ETA recalculation and per-leg table
Route waypoints can be dragged directly on the map
Route/Voyage Library with open, edit, rename, duplicate and delete
Professional Track History with named recordings, distance, duration and average speed
Marine/User Marks with saved details, coordinates, drag editing and double-click info
Separate Fleet Tracking layer with public real-telemetry position hook
limitations: Research/prototype navigation display; not type-approved ECDIS
AIS static-voyage message decoding and internet MarineTraffic API integration are not yet included
Fleet markers require real fleet telemetry coordinates; no invented operational positions are shown
S-57 portrayal is not full IHO S-52 yet
CM93 native decoding is not implemented
